text:
Jamie: Passing WillowCrest (enterprise) to CS — contract signed yesterday. Key bits: private deployment (VPC), Okta SSO, EMEA data residency, KMS integration + SOC2 evidence requested. Renewal in ~9 months. Expected initial ingestion ~10k tokens/day; sales committed baseline 4k req/day with bursts to ~50 req/s. Claire Bowen (customer CFO) on copy for budget.
Maya: Thanks — tagging in. I will own the onboarding program. Need the exact contract SKU and any committed qps vs token limits so we can size Dedicated. Also: do they have an existing cloud account for VPC peering or we spin a customer-provisioned VPC?
Jamie: SKU WIL-ENT-2026. Committed baseline is 4k req/day, burst up to 50r/s. They want a dedicated capacity estimate and a suggested 8-week onboarding timeline. Customer prefers customer-managed VPC peering into our Private connector.
Ava: For 50r/s with ~8s median response we're looking at modest concurrency; rough calc suggests a Dedicated pool equivalent to 2 x A40-class nodes for initial ramp, add autoscale to 4 nodes for peak headroom. I'll sketch a capacity plan and cost estimate this afternoon.
Omar: Heads up — KMS/HSM integration adds a security engineering touchpoint. We'll need encryption-at-rest key wrapping flow and a short design doc for HSM access patterns. Also confirm if they need bring-your-own-key (BYOK) or if Redwood KMS is acceptable.
Priya: I'll draft a support runbook (triage playbook + escalation list) and a post-onboarding SLA acceptance checklist. Who's the engineering on-call that will be the primary during cutover?
Liza: I'll run exec updates and own renewal risk tracking. Risk notes: CFO involvement = procurement scrutiny; EMEA residency means additional legal review; SOC2 evidence could add 2-3 weeks. Add a renewal alert trigger at month 6 so CS can prep renewal ops.
Jamie: Procurement timeline looks like 3-4 weeks for final network approvals. They asked for a simple preflight checklist for internal IT to provision peering. I pasted a starter below.
Jamie: ```
# WillowCrest preflight checklist (customer)
- VPC CIDR: confirm /16 or /20 availability
- Shared routes & peering: allow TCP 443 to 10.10.0.0/16
- Okta metadata (IdP): SAML metadata XML or OIDC issuer URL
- Firewall: allow outbound to our control plane IPs (listed in contract appendix)
- KMS: provide key ARN or KMS contact
```
Maya: Nice. Action owners / next steps:
- Maya: prepare onboarding plan + project timeline (.ppt) and share by Tue 03/12.
- Ava: capacity & infra estimate + Dedicated sizing by EOD today.
- Omar: security/HSM integration feasibility doc and rough effort estimate by Fri.
- Priya: support runbook draft by Mon and oncall handover template.
- Liza: set renewal watch and create 6-month playbook.
- Jamie: intro to Claire and IT lead (done), please push contact for IT network engineer.
Ava: Question — do we want to propose canary cutover (staged traffic) or big-bang? Canary would require an alternate routing policy; suggests we keep a small hosted fallback for 2 weeks.
Maya: Canary preferred. Plan: week 1 staging / smoke tests, week 2 limited production (10% traffic), week 3 full prod. Add metrics: latency P50/P95, token cost per 1k, error rate target <0.5%.
Omar: For SOC2 evidence, we can provide our standard artifact pack but customer may ask for additional encryption attestations. I'll coordinate with security and legal.
Priya: I'll schedule a 60-min cutover dry-run with our oncall and customer's IT two weeks before prod.
deploy-bot: Deployment window available: 03/25 0200-0500 UTC; reserve slot? :calendar:
Liza: Reserve tentative slot. Also flag: renewal risk score = medium-high due to strict procurement + single customer-decision maker. We'll track weekly for first 8 weeks.
Jamie: One more risk: usage could spike beyond committed baseline if they batch jobs. Recommend quota guardrails and rate-limits during initial 30 days.
Maya: Agreed. I'll add a traffic guard in the onboarding checklist and a customer-visible quota dashboard link.
Ava: I'll include test prompts and evaluation set to monitor quality regressions during rollout; also recommend quantized model variant for cost-savings if latency OK.
Omar: Need an engineer assigned to the cutover window. @Omar — can you cover primary or assign an alternative?
Omar: I can be primary for the cutover windows but will need a backup. Tagging @Priya to own backup coordination.
Priya: Got it — I'll be the backup and own the support paging list during the window.
Maya: Great. I'll produce the handoff doc with owners + timeline + risks and post it here once complete.
Jamie: Thanks everyone. Claire — looping you for visibility. Expect a CS kickoff invite shortly.
Maya: Closing note: Acceptance criteria for go-live: successful SSO login, VPC peering verified, KMS key rotations tested, latency within agreed P95, and sign-off from WillowCrest IT.
